# ellipkf

> Compute the [complete elliptic integral of the first kind][elliptic-integral] for a single-precision floating-point number.

<section class="intro">

The [complete elliptic integral of the first kind][elliptic-integral] is defined as

<!-- <equation class="equation" label="eq:complete_elliptic_integral_first_kind" align="center" raw="K(m)=\int_0^\tfrac{\pi}{2} \frac{d\theta}{\sqrt{1-m \sin^2\theta}}" alt="Complete elliptic integral of the first kind"> -->

```math
K(m)=\int_0^\tfrac{\pi}{2} \frac{d\theta}{\sqrt{1-m \sin^2\theta}}
```

<!-- </equation> -->

where the parameter `m` is related to the modulus `k` by `m = k^2`.

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var ellipkf = require( '@stdlib/math/base/special/ellipkf' );
```

#### ellipkf( m )

Computes the [complete elliptic integral of the first kind][elliptic-integral] for a single-precision floating-point number.

```javascript
var v = ellipkf( 0.5 );
// returns ~1.854

v = ellipkf( -1.0 );
// returns ~1.311

v = ellipkf( 2.0 );
// returns NaN

v = ellipkf( Infinity );
// returns NaN

v = ellipkf( -Infinity );
// returns NaN

v = ellipkf( NaN );
// returns NaN
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   This function is valid for `-∞ < m <= 1`.

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var uniform = require( '@stdlib/random/array/uniform' );
var logEachMap = require( '@stdlib/console/log-each-map' );
var ellipkf = require( '@stdlib/math/base/special/ellipkf' );

var opts = {
    'dtype': 'float32'
};
var m = uniform( 100, -1.0, 1.0, opts );

logEachMap( 'ellipkf(%0.4f) = %0.4f', m, ellipkf );
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->

<!-- C usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

### Usage

```c
#include "stdlib/math/base/special/ellipkf.h"
```

#### stdlib_base_ellipkf( m )

Computes the [complete elliptic integral of the first kind][elliptic-integral] for a single-precision floating-point number.

```c
float out = stdlib_base_ellipkf( 0.5f );
// returns ~1.854f

out = stdlib_base_ellipkf( -1.0f );
// returns ~1.311f
```

The function accepts the following arguments:

-   **x**: `[in] float` input value.

```c
float stdlib_base_ellipkf( const float m );
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<!-- C API usage notes. Make sure to keep an empty line after the `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="notes">

</section>

<!-- C API usage examples. -->

<section class="examples">

### Examples

```c
#include "stdlib/math/base/special/ellipkf.h"
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdio.h>

int main( void ) {
    float m;
    float v;
    int i;

    for ( i = 0; i < 100; i++ ) {
        m = -1.0f + ( ( (float)rand() / (float)RAND_MAX ) * 2.0f );
        v = stdlib_base_ellipkf( m );
        printf( "ellipkf(%f) = %f\n", m, v );
    }
}
```

</section>
